title: The 'drag the skiff free' might-check at the Ironbound Mission kept escalating DC after each failure (10→22 cap) with only a 1hp cost per try and no way to know in advance it capped that high; after 3 fails it became effectively unwinnable at my stat level, and there was no alternate route hinted at from that specific room (the real route to the drowned nave was reached from a completely different, non-obvious path via Reedholm's 'go out').
